messages:
elaine (prod-eng): kicking off apac2 canary for v2.4.7 — starting at 8:15UTC, 8% traffic. Run prefix-check + lightweight synth, watch p50/p95 and 5xx.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: rollout/v2.4.7 -> apac2-canary (8%)
rob (eng-releases): paste checklist: `./ci/smoke/prefix_check.sh --env=apac2 --routes=/v1/gen,/v1/embed --samples=60`
sai (sre): started probes. alert thresholds: p95>180ms (warn), p95>240ms (page), 5xx>0.4% (page).
deploy-bot: Probe run 1/2: prefix-check OK for gen, embed p95=175ms, 5xx=0, sample_count=60
infra-bot: notice: short-lived DNS flapping detected on apac2 edge at t+40s, brief spike in connection resets. Notified edge-team.
sai (sre): saw ~3 connection resets in traces for embed route, tail unaffected. tagging @rob. Might correlate with edge DNS flap.
rob (eng-releases): can we replay synth excluding edge-gw-09? `./ci/smoke/replay.sh --exclude edge-gw-09`
sai (sre): replaying against apac2-canary excluding edge-gw-09 now.
deploy-bot: Probe run 2/2 (excl edge-gw-09): embed p95=159ms, gen p95=120ms, 5xx=0, samples_ok=120/120
elaine (prod-eng): ok — decision point: proceed to 25% or pin embed back to v2.4.5 and only ramp gen? Thoughts?
rob (eng-releases): leaning pin-embed -> v2.4.5. DNS flaps are external and pin reduces blast radius while edge-team investigates.
sai (sre): agree. add auto-fallback: if embed 5xx > 0.2% for 2m OR p95>200ms sustained 3m, auto-pin to v2.4.5 and rollback traffic to 8%.
elaine (prod-eng): adding that policy now. also add a note to release notes: "apac2 canary: embed pinned pending edge DNS investigation; gen proceeds"
infra-bot: Edge ticket created: EDGE-1289 - investigate apac2 DNS flapping (link: https://infra.redwood/EDGE-1289)
rob (eng-releases): rollout updated: apac2-canary -> gen-route=v2.4.7 (25%), embed-route=v2.4.5 (pinned)
sai (sre): uploading probe artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/rollouts/4509876543/v2.4.7/prefix_checks.tar.gz
elaine (prod-eng): scheduling final ramp check at t+30m. If clean, we'll finish rollout and publish release notes with the embed pin and edge link. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout progress t+12m: gen p95=122ms, embed (pinned) p95=158ms, 5xx=0, alarms=none
rob (eng-releases): closing thread. ongoing monitoring in #eng-runtime. follow-ups in EDGE-1289 for edge team.
